1  HON'BLE SANDEEP JAIN, J. 
1. Heard Shri Shivam Yadav, learned counsel for the appellant and Shri Ramesh Kumar Singh for the Meerut Development Authority, respondent no.3.

2. The instant first appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has been filed by the land owner against the award and decree dated 17.11.2017 passed by the Court of Additional District Judge, Court No.13, Meerut in LAR No.323 of 1992, Jagdish Chand vs. State of U.P. and others,
whereby the compensation awarded by the Collector at the rate of Rs. 50/- per sq. yard for the acquired land situated in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut, has been upheld.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Court No.13, Meerut
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Jagdish Chand vs. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the land-owner-appellant submitted that for similarly situated land acquired vide notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 14.08.1987, this Court in First Appeal No.1013 of 2004, Meerut Development Authority vs. Khubi and others, connected with six other first appeals vide order dated 16.02.2016 and also this Court in First Appeal (Defective) No.412 of 2003, Meerut Development Authority vs. Omvir Singh and others, connected with 24 other first appeals vide order dated 10.05.2016, has held that compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard, is payable for the acquired land.
4. Learned counsel submitted that the above orders of this Court has been passed on the basis of the judgment of the Apex Court dated 30.04.1997 in the case of Meharban and others vs. State of U.P.
and others,

and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: whereby for similarly acquired land, situated in Village Nagla Tasi, compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard has been awarded by the Apex Court.

5. Learned counsel submitted that since the matter relating to acquisition of land in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut has attained finality and the Apex Court and this Court has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard, as such, the appellant is also entitled to get the compensation for his acquired land situated in the same village at the same rate at which it has been determined by the Apex Court and this Court in the above mentioned cases.

6. Per-contra, learned counsel representing the Meerut Development Authority very fairly accepted that the matter relating the acquisition of land situated in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut has attained finality, since the Apex Court and this Court has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard.
7. I have considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

8. It is apparent that the instant appeal relates to the acquisition of land situated in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut vide notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 14.08.1987,
pursuant to which the award by the Collector was made on 22.02.1990, whereby compensation at the rate of Rs.50/- per sq. yard was awarded, besides other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The Collector's award was challenged by the land owner by filing a Jagdish Chand vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31690414/
2 reference, which has been dismissed by the impugned award and decree dated 17.11.2017, whereby the award of the Collector has been upheld and the reference court came to the conclusion that the appellant is not entitled to get any enhanced compensation.
9.

sentences.text: It is apparent that for similarly acquired land, through notification dated 14.08.1987, the Apex Court in the case of Meharban and others vs. State of U.P., reported in AIR 1997 SC 2664 has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard, besides other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

entities.text: Meharban and others vs. State of U.P., reported in AIR 1997 SC 2664
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The above judgment of the Apex Court has been followed by this Court in First Appeal No.1013 of 2004, Meerut Development Authority vs. Khubi and others, connected with six other first appeals and also in First Appeal (Defective) No.412 of 2003, Meerut Development Authority vs. Omvir Singh and others, connected with 24 other first appeals, wherein by orders dated 16.02.2016 and 10.05.2016, respectively, this Court has also awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.175/- per sq. yard for similarly situated acquired land in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut.
10.

entities.text: Meerut Development Authority vs. Khubi and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Meerut Development Authority vs. Omvir Singh and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of this, the appellant is also entitled to get the same rate of compensation for its acquired land situated in Village Nagla Tasi, as has been awarded by the Apex Court and this Court in the above mentioned cases.
11. Accordingly, the instant appeal is allowed.

The appellant is entitled to get enhanced compensation for his acquired land situated in Village Nagla Tasi, Kasimpur, District Meerut at the rate of Rs. 175/- per square yard along with 30% solatium, additional compensation @ 12% per annum and enhanced interest under Section 28, as provided under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
12. However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be no order as to costs.
13. Office is directed to prepare the decree accordingly.

(Sandeep Jain,J.) September 3, 2025 Mayank  Jagdish Chand vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31690414/
